method: Saved Council research supplied the exact substitute identity, sponsor, source byte evidence, and blank-enactment limitation. Targeted primary-source reconciliation used City Legistar legislative-detail histories and, for O-24-4, the City Clerk notice of publication. A final instrument is authoritative because it carries the recorded enactment and final action; a held substitute is never described as that final instrument merely because it was substituted.
